title: Safety Signage
seoTitle: Occupational Safety Signage Manufacturing in Istanbul
description: Warning signs, instruction boards and hazard symbols manufactured to ISO 3864 and TSE standards in Istanbul.
heroDesc: We manufacture warning signs, instruction boards and hazard symbols that meet workplace safety requirements, designed to ISO 3864, TSE and OSHA standards. Produced on PVC, plastic, steel and aluminium with UV-resistant printing rated for five years or more outdoors.
listDesc: Warning, prohibition, information and fire safety signs compliant with occupational safety regulations. Photoluminescent and standard options.

features.title: ISO 3864 Standards
features.desc: Signs designed and manufactured to the international standard for safety signs and colours.

features.title: Warning and Hazard Symbols
features.desc: Electrical, chemical, mechanical and biological hazard symbols in the standard yellow, red, blue and black.

features.title: Instruction and Wayfinding Boards
features.desc: Work instruction signs, emergency exit routes and fire extinguisher location markers.

features.title: Industrial Materials
features.desc: PVC, plastic, aluminium and galvanised steel, suitable for outdoor use and harsh conditions.

features.title: UV-Resistant Printing
features.desc: UV-resistant inks that hold their colour for five years or more in outdoor applications.

features.title: Custom Designs and Sizes
features.desc: Signs designed in your corporate colours, in standard or custom sizes.

products.title: Occupational Safety Signs

process.title: Standards and Requirements
process.desc: We determine which signs are needed from the type of workplace and its safety requirements.

process.title: Design and Compliance
process.desc: Designs are prepared to ISO 3864 and TSE standards and submitted for your approval.

process.title: Production and Printing
process.desc: UV-resistant printing onto the chosen material, in standard or custom sizes.

process.title: Delivery and Placement Advice
process.desc: Signs are delivered, with guidance on where each one should be positioned if required.

faq.q: Which standards do the signs follow?
faq.a: Signs are designed to ISO 3864, TSE and OSHA standards. In Turkey, compliance with the occupational health and safety regulations is mandatory.
Aluminium, galvanised steel and specialist PVC last five years or more outdoors. Plain PVC is suitable for short-term use.

faq.q: Can we have custom colours and our logo?
faq.a: Yes. Alongside the standard ISO colours we can produce signs in your corporate colours and carry your logo.
The ISO standard sets minimum sizes based on viewing distance. As an example, a sign that must be legible from 5 m should be 50 × 50 cm.
Yes. We advise on sign positioning based on the layout of the workplace and the requirements of the OSHA and TSE regulations.
